Text-to-speech with explicit MP3 response format

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import CreateSpeechRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    req = CreateSpeechRequest.from_json("{\"input\":\"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.\",\"model\":\"tts-1-hd\",\"response_format\":\"mp3\",\"speed\":1.0,\"voice\":\"nova\"}")
    result = await client.speech(req)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
